sourceOfTruth: User decisions in this grill session
package.json, apps/agent-runtime/package.json, vitest.config.ts, vercel.json, Dockerfile, compose.yaml
decisions: Operating model: an anchor organization (NGO, employment center or program) licenses WorkBridge and provides counselors; employers publish free; candidates arrive through the organization; one anchor organization in v1.
v1 modules: candidate, employer, counselor plus an operator panel, a training-center portal and a simulated-interview UI; analytics is deferred to v1.1 and answered with SQL.
Supply: employers publish directly plus operator-uploaded curated vacancies (CSV or internal API); no scraping in v1; training centers publish their own courses.
Credential verification: Accredible then Credly; Certo is an optional adapter; the mock is development-only.
Email: Resend behind an in-repo adapter with SMTP fallback; the SQL outbox remains the source of truth.
Observability: Sentry for errors, OpenTelemetry across web/runtime/worker, Langfuse for agent spans, on top of the internal audit log.
Bun is the package manager, workspace resolver and script runner; production stays on Node.js 22 and tests stay on Vitest.
Hono replaces the hand-written node:http router.
Drizzle ORM with drizzle-kit becomes the schema source, baselined from migrations/001..004.
Ajv + JSON Schema for domain contracts; Zod for HTTP input, forms and environment.
Web data: React Server Components and Server Actions; TanStack Query only for live data.
Deployment: containers for web, runtime and worker on one PaaS with Neon; the Vercel function is retired.
Kept: Next.js 16, React 19, Mastra, Better Auth, Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, Google Maps, OpenRouter, Vitest, Playwright, Spanish-only product, single-anchor tenancy.

migrationPhases: 0 Bun: bun install/run, bun.lock, Dockerfile and CI; exit when bun run gate:ci is green
1 Hono: wrap the service and port runtime routes; exit with contract tests equivalent to today's
2 Drizzle: baseline from 001..004 and migrate modules one by one; exit when generated schema matches the database
3 Web: RSC + Server Actions replace manual fetch; exit with candidate/employer/counselor e2e green
4 PaaS: containers for web/runtime/worker, retire vercel.json; exit with a reproducible end-to-end deploy
5 Integrations: Resend, Sentry/OTel, Accredible/Credly; exit with a delivered email, a Sentry event and a verified credential
